name: block-converter-for-divi-dev
description: Development-only tooling. Not shipped in the plugin ZIP — see bin/build-zip.sh.
comment:overrides: wp-env unpacks the WordPress it downloads with a zip library, and both libraries it has used have had an advisory against the version it asked for: extract-zip 1.7.0 (GHSA-jmr9-qjv8-65gv, symlink path traversal, never patched) and now adm-zip <0.6.0 (GHSA-xcpc-8h2w-3j85). 11.13.0 moved to adm-zip and pins ^0.5.9, which cannot take the fixed 0.6.0 on its own. Nothing here ships in the plugin ZIP, but a development machine unpacking archives is still a machine, and `npm audit` is only a gate while it is clean. Drop this when wp-env widens its own range.
